compile.globalConstraints:
- The PR body is unchanged: the `### Residuals` checklist still sits after `### Plan` and before the
  `Closes #<n>` lines, one `- [ ]` line per item, and no section at all when there is none.
- The boot rig's `POST …/issues` and `GET …/issues/<n>` curl arms in
  `fleet/tests/_sandbox_boot_helpers.mjs` stay as they are at BASE, so an absent `issues.log` is an
  observed absence and not a vacuous one.
- The ledger is append-only: no script rewrites an existing ledger line, and a second pass over the
  same run appends nothing.
- No document names the per-run follow-up issue as a thing the fleet does: `fleet/CONTRACT.md`
  carries no `POST /repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues`, no `publish:followup`, and `watch-item` only where
  ultralearn's distill procedure already names it.

**Acceptance:** suite — the committed suite is the verification.
